attchmntText: Tarapur Transformers Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Tarapur Transformers Limited submitted copies of newspaper publications for its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results at a meeting held on November 06, 2026. The extract was published in the Active Times on November 07, 2026, and in the Mumbai Mitra on November 07, 2026. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, the net profit after tax was 55.44 lacs. The net profit for the half year ended September 30, 2026, was 39.88 lacs. The equity share capital remains at 1950.00 lacs. The earnings per share for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, was 0.28. The results were reviewed by the Audit Committee.

attchmntText: Tarapur Transformers Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the unaudited financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
